Assassin Update (6 August 2025) – Shock And Awe Update (28 January 2026)
Number is the damage dealt in the inner explosion sphere. Splash damage is decreased linearly if the enemy is in the outer explosion sphere.
DPS is calculated as (Damage × Ammo) ÷ (Reload Time + Rev Time + (Firerate × Ammo)) + Splash Damage ÷ Missile Cooldown. DPS assumes missiles only hit one enemy.

Smaller = Bigger Update (26 May 2020) – Overhaul Update (29 October 2020)
Number is the damage dealt in the inner explosion sphere. Splash damage is decreased linearly if the enemy is in the outer explosion sphere.
Through splash damage, its missiles can indirectly hit hidden enemies, but this tower cannot directly target hidden enemies.
Total DPS is calculated as Gun DPS + Missile DPS.
Missile DPS assumes that only one enemy is hit and receives the full explosive damage.
